campaigns.name: EGFR / Kinase Hinge Lead Series
campaigns.objective: Identify orally bioavailable 4-anilinoquinazoline and pyrimidine analogs with sub-50 nM EGFR potency and clean hERG margin (>30x).

campaigns.name: Broad-Spectrum Coronavirus Mpro Screen
campaigns.objective: Screen reversible-covalent peptidomimetic scaffolds optimizing metabolic stability (HLM t1/2 > 60 min) and CYP3A4 avoidance.

targets.name: Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR L858R)
targets.bindingSiteProfile: ATP-competitive hinge region (Met793 H-bond donor/acceptor), hydrophobic back pocket (Thr790 gatekeeper), solvent-exposed morpholine channel.
targets.assayProtocol: HTRF KinEASE-TK biochemical phosphorylation assay at 10 uM ATP Km

targets.name: BCR-ABL1 Tyrosine Kinase
targets.bindingSiteProfile: DFG-out inactive conformation pocket; hinge Met318 H-bond, Glu286/Asp381 amide linker pair, lipophilic trifluoromethyl-adjacent pocket.
targets.assayProtocol: Caliper microfluidic mobility-shift kinase assay & Ba/F3 proliferation

targets.name: SARS-CoV-2 Main Protease (3CLpro)
targets.bindingSiteProfile: Catalytic dyad (Cys145, His41), S1 Gln-mimetic lactam pocket (His163, Glu166), hydrophobic S2 cyclopropyl/bicycloproline subsite.

targets.name: KRAS G12C Oncoprotein
targets.bindingSiteProfile: Switch-II cryptic allosteric pocket beneath GDP/GTP site; covalent warhead engagement with mutant Cys12 thiol.
targets.assayProtocol: Intact protein mass-spec Cys12 occupancy + SOS1-mediated nucleotide exchange

targets.name: Cyclooxygenase-2 (PTGS2)
targets.bindingSiteProfile: Elongated hydrophobic arachidonate channel leading to catalytic Tyr385 / Ser530 and Arg120 carboxylate anchor.
targets.assayProtocol: COX Fluorescent Activity Assay (arachidonic acid / ADHP)

targets.name: HMG-CoA Reductase
targets.bindingSiteProfile: Shallow polar statin-binding groove recognizing 3,5-dihydroxyheptanoic acid pharmacophore via Arg590, Lys691, and Glu559.
targets.assayProtocol: Spectrophotometric NADPH oxidation kinetics at 340 nm

assays.name: EGFR WT vs. L858R Biochemical IC50 Panel
hERG Potassium Channel Automated Patch Clamp
3CLpro FRET Protease Inhibition & Reversibility
assays.acceptanceCriteria: Ki < 20 nM with < 10% host Cathepsin-L inhibition at 10 uM

assays.name: Human Liver Microsome Intrinsic Clearance & CYP3A4
KRAS G12C Covalent Engagement MS Assay
assays.acceptanceCriteria: > 85% covalent occupancy at 1 uM with minimal GSH reactivity

bioactivity.mechanismHypothesis: Reversible ATP-competitive kinase inhibition anchored by the quinazoline N1 nitrogen at the EGFR hinge region.
bindingInteractions: Quinazoline N1 accepts a hydrogen bond from hinge Met793 backbone NH
3-Chloro-4-fluoroaniline ring occupies the hydrophobic back pocket near gatekeeper Thr790
C6 propyl-morpholine tail extends into the solvent-accessible ribose/phosphate channel
C7 methoxy group forms stabilizing van der Waals contacts along the hinge floor
bioactivity.selectivityNotes: High selectivity for ErbB1/EGFR over off-target Ser/Thr kinases; moderate cross-reactivity with ErbB2 at micromolar concentrations.

toxicity.metabolicStability: Moderate clearance via CYP3A4/CYP2D6 O-demethylation and morpholine ring oxidation.
safetyAlerts: Basic tertiary amine on propyl-morpholine tail introduces moderate hERG channel affinity risk
CYP3A4 substrate/inhibitor liability requires drug-drug interaction profiling
toxicity.toxicologySummary: Favorable oral absorption and non-mutagenic profile, with class-typical hERG and hepatic transaminase monitoring warranted.

optimizations.title: Reduce Basicity of Solvent Morpholine Tail
optimizations.rationale: Replacing the morpholine oxygen or introducing an adjacent difluoro group attenuates pKa and lowers hERG channel affinity.
optimizations.expectedImpact: Expected 3-fold reduction in hERG inhibition while preserving hinge potency.

analysis.executiveSummary: MV-101 exhibits potent predicted EGFR L858R engagement (18-35 nM) with clean Lipinski/Veber oral compliance. Primary optimization focus should mitigate moderate hERG liability on the basic morpholine side chain.

review.notes: Confirmed benchmark potency and hinge pharmacophore; prioritized morpholine pKa-attenuated analogs.

bioactivity.mechanismHypothesis: ATP-competitive 4-anilinoquinazoline binding with terminal meta-ethynyl group penetrating the gatekeeper pocket.
bindingInteractions: Quinazoline N1 forms key H-bond with Met793 hinge backbone
3-Ethynylphenyl ring aligns tightly inside the Thr790 hydrophobic pocket
Bis(2-methoxyethoxy) chains improve aqueous solvation along solvent front
bioactivity.selectivityNotes: Tighter steric fit in EGFR ATP cleft relative to bulkier ErbB2 pocket.

toxicity.metabolicStability: Terminal alkyne oxidation and O-dealkylation of methoxyethoxy tails via CYP3A4/CYP1A2.
safetyAlerts: Terminal acetylene moiety can undergo CYP-mediated reactive metabolite formation
toxicity.toxicologySummary: Low hERG risk due to neutral methoxyethoxy chains; monitor glutathione trapping for alkyne bioactivation.

optimizations.title: Terminal Alkyne Bioisostere (Cyano Substitution)
optimizations.rationale: Replacing the terminal ethynyl with a nitrile eliminates CYP-mediated ketene reactive metabolites while retaining linear geometry.
optimizations.expectedImpact: Eliminates reactive metabolite alert and lowers cLogP by ~0.5 units.

analysis.executiveSummary: MV-108 achieves strong sub-30 nM EGFR prediction with reduced hERG risk compared to basic-amine series. Nitrile bioisostere is recommended to remove terminal alkyne metabolic alerts.

review.notes: Schedule GSH adduct trapping and CYP3A4 time-dependent inhibition panel.

bioactivity.mechanismHypothesis: Type-II DFG-out kinase inhibitor stabilizing the inactive activation-loop conformation of ABL1.
bindingInteractions: Pyridine-pyrimidine core anchors to hinge Met318 via H-bond
Central amide linker bridges catalytic Glu286 and Asp381 backbone NH
N-methylpiperazine tail engages Asp363 via electrostatic interaction
bioactivity.selectivityNotes: Selectively targets ABL1, c-KIT, and PDGFR with minimal off-target activity against EGFR.

toxicity.metabolicStability: N-demethylation of piperazine ring forms active N-desmethyl metabolite via CYP3A4.
safetyAlerts: Piperazine tertiary amine + extended aromatic scaffold increases hERG blockade probability
toxicity.toxicologySummary: Well-tolerated non-mutagenic profile with moderate CYP3A4 and hERG considerations.

optimizations.title: Fluorine Block on Central Phenyl Ring
optimizations.rationale: Introducing an ortho-fluorine on the benzamide ring reduces metabolic hydroxylation.
optimizations.expectedImpact: Improves human liver microsome half-life without disrupting DFG-out amide angle.

analysis.executiveSummary: MV-204 demonstrates strong Type-II DFG-out affinity for BCR-ABL1 with favorable oral drug-likeness. Monitor hERG window and CYP3A4 N-demethylation rate.

review.notes: Awaiting Caliper ABL1 WT/T315I panel readout.

bioactivity.mechanismHypothesis: Reversible covalent thioimidate adduct formation between the electrophilic nitrile warhead and catalytic Cys145.
bindingInteractions: Nitrile carbon undergoes nucleophilic attack by catalytic Cys145 thiolate
Gamma-lactam P1 ring mimics endogenous Gln forming H-bonds with His163 and Glu166
Bicyclic dimethylcyclopropylproline P2 core fills hydrophobic S2 subsite
Trifluoroacetamide P3 cap anchors into S4 pocket while avoiding P-gp efflux
bioactivity.selectivityNotes: High selectivity over mammalian serine and cysteine proteases (Cathepsin L/B > 1000x).

toxicity.metabolicStability: Susceptible to CYP3A4 oxidation on tert-butyl and bicyclic proline moieties; co-dosing or deuteration strategies applicable.
safetyAlerts: No PAINS alerts; reversible nitrile warhead avoids off-target covalent labeling
toxicity.toxicologySummary: Exceptionally clean safety pharmacology profile across hERG, Ames, and cytotoxicity panels.

optimizations.title: Ketoamide Warhead Exploration
optimizations.rationale: Evaluates alternative reversible covalent kinetics for prolonged target residence time.
optimizations.expectedImpact: Potentially slower off-rate at the cost of +1 HBD and higher TPSA.

analysis.executiveSummary: MV-301 shows single-digit nanomolar 3CLpro potency with clean toxicology and zero Lipinski violations. Primary developmental focus is CYP3A4 clearance rate optimization.

review.notes: Selected as antiviral lead benchmark; PK boosting / deuterated P3 analogs under evaluation.

bioactivity.mechanismHypothesis: Irreversible covalent alkylation of mutant Cys12 paired with non-covalent Switch-II pocket locking.
bindingInteractions: Acrylamide warhead forms covalent thioether bond with KRAS G12C Cys12
Fluorophenol substituent forms H-bond network inside cryptic His95 groove
Atropisomeric isopropyl-pyridine occupies lipophilic Switch-II subpocket
bioactivity.selectivityNotes: Selective for KRAS G12C mutant over wild-type KRAS/NRAS/HRAS lacking Cys12.

toxicity.metabolicStability: Moderate glutathione conjugation on acrylamide warhead and CYP3A4 oxidation on isopropyl-pyridine.
safetyAlerts: Michael acceptor acrylamide warhead requires non-specific thiol reactivity profiling
Molecular weight exceeds 550 Da (1 Lipinski violation; acceptable beyond-Rule-of-5 space)
toxicity.toxicologySummary: Acceptable safety margin for oncology covalent modality; track hepatic ALT/AST and GSH conjugation rate.

optimizations.title: Fluoro-Acrylamide Reactivity Tuning
optimizations.rationale: Modulates Michael acceptor electrophilicity to lower off-target plasma thiol conjugation.
optimizations.expectedImpact: Reduces non-specific GSH half-life reactivity while retaining Cys12 k_inact.

analysis.executiveSummary: MV-412 shows potent Switch-II KRAS G12C occupancy despite elevated MW (560 Da). Tuning warhead electrophilicity is advised to minimize off-target thiol reactivity.

review.notes: Confirm atropisomer stability barrier and RapidFire Cys12 covalent k_inact/Ki.
